findings.title: Join timeout does not bound teardown
findings.detail: DuoScreenCompositor.stopBlocking calls runOnGlThread, whose latch.await() has no timeout, on the main thread before glThread.stop() does the timed 1 s join. A GL thread stuck mid-frame (e.g. eglSwapBuffers on a dying surface) would still hang onSurfaceDestroyed. Consider latch.await(timeout) on the release path.

findings.title: Restart path untested end to end
findings.detail: DuoScreenThreadSlotTest uses plain JVM threads. Run the available->destroyed->available and available->available cycles once on DHU to confirm EGL re-init and pane relaunch on a real car surface.
